scenes.script:
Lakshmi says: What are you doing? I am removing my jacket.
Miss Nova says: Removing? Adhi emanna permanently delete chesthunnara? Clothes ki manam 'taking off' ani anali. 'I am taking off my jacket' ani cheppadaniki try cheyandi.
Lakshmi says: I am taking off my jacket. Oh, nenu English matladalsi vachinappudalla freeze aypothanu.
Miss Nova says: Adhi chala normal! Nenu Miss Nova. Supernova AI lo, nenu andariki oke lessons ivvanu. Mee level ni analyze chesi, mee kosame oka personalized plan ready chesthanu.
Lakshmi says: Kani nenu mistakes chesthe?
Miss Nova says: Rathiri 3 a.m. ki ayina sare, veyyi mistakes cheyandi! Nenu eppudu mimmalni judge cheyanu, chusi navvanu.
